[[Gunslinger Charm]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gunslinger Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the [[Gunslinger]] enemy. When you bought the plushie, Instantly after the purchase you would be emailed a code, which allows you to get [[GunSlinger Nametag]] and [[Gunslinger Charm]]. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 7 inches tall, 6.25 inches wide and 4.3 inches deep, or 17.78 centimetres tall, 15.875 centimetres wide and 10.922 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Gunslinger Mini Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online''' *:Bring home your new favorite gaming buddy today! ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Gunslinger Mini Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $16.99. You could also buy the Mini Boss Bundle, which came with all five boss plushies, which had a cost of $76.45. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} GunslingerPlushShowcase1.png GunslingerPlushShowcase2.png GunslingerPlushShowcase3.png GunslingerPlushShowcase4.png GunslingerPlushShowcase5.png }} ==Trivia== *The '''Gunslinger Mini Plush''', alongside other boss mini plushies that released alongside it, are the only plushies to give out the code instantly instead of after 24 hours. {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
